git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(mission): bind active-mission dispatch sidecar at worker-spawn match, not dispatch time

The active-mission sidecar `ethos mission dispatch`/`create` writes bound
the session to the mission indefinitely, so the next Agent() spawn in that
session -- however unrelated -- was captured as a Tier B delegation of it.
Reproduced live 2026-09-07: a throwaway probe mission attributed the
leader's own unrelated PR-fix agent (ethos-7tqd).

DES-076: a BindOriginDispatch binding is now single-use, consumed only by
the one spawn whose agent type matches the contract's declared Worker. A
mismatched spawn proceeds unbound and leaves the sidecar in place for the
real worker; a matching spawn binds Tier B and the sidecar is cleared
immediately after. BindOriginClaim (`ethos mission claim`) is unaffected
and stays sticky, per its existing operator-intent semantics.

The abandon-cleanup half of the mission (letting `mission abandon` retire a
mission whose only delegation was a capture) is out of scope for this
change: it requires a bind-provenance field on Delegation/DelegationSkeleton
and a narrowly-gated disclaim path on Store.Abandon, both in
internal/mission/{store,delegation}.go -- outside this mission's write-set.
Documented as a non-goal in DES-076 with a recommended follow-up scope.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
